snippet.title: ACORN: Seed of Resistance - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Ghost Ship Publishing and Guidelight Games, creators of SpellRogue, are excited to reveal ACORN: Seed of Resistance, a new RPG auto-battler that combines tactical team-building, roguelike runs and exploration with a dark fantasy woodland setting where the creatures at the bottom of the food chain are fighting back.

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4714570/ACORN_Seed_of_Resistance/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=acorn_pre_big_break_trailer&utm_content=description

Coming 2027

--------------------
Acorn: Seed of Resistance puts players in charge of an unlikely resistance of woodland creatures, tasking them with rebuilding a fallen order and fighting to reclaim their home. Drawing inspiration from classic strategy games while designed to be approachable to a wider audience, Acorn: Seed of Resistance  lets players explore procedurally generated lands, recruit new companions, develop their party, and make strategic decisions that can mean the difference between survival and defeat. 
--------------------
Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4714570/ACORN_Seed_of_Resistance/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=acorn_pre_big_break_trailer&utm_content=description
--------------------
